data.body: CI infra note for the resumer: Gerrit Verified Gate run 32306986850 briefly reached in_progress and was then REQUEUED back to 'queued' without producing a verdict, alongside 32306779189. That is runner eviction/starvation in the GitHub Actions pool, not a flaky test and not a fault of this change, so it must not be treated as a failing gate or answered with a recheck. Local evidence stands: lint, typecheck, tests/unit (11290), tests/scripts (1046), tests/interfaces+tests/lib (1932), and the criterion's own 18 tests all pass on PS2 (78c9cce398).
